text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
People are crowding in front of the
central plaza.
I'm curious, so I go to
check it out.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Ahem. Ah... Hello, darling p-pony.
Whaddya
wanna—I mean... Is there
anything that might be
bothering you?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Uh, Hishiama?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
This darkening of your lovely eyes must
mean...
Uh, you'd like me to stop...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: The hell are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Brian! Your... your hair is looking
lovely
today! So lovely... that I want to
take you on,
one-on-one!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Sigh. Come here a minute.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
So why the Fuji impersonation all of a
sudden?
Thought you hated acting all
dramatic.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but this is... I have my reasons,
all
right?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
See, that student back there lives in my
dorm. She
always seems worried about
something.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: She opened up to Fuji, apparently, but as her dorm leader, I'm supposed to be the one she goes to!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Does she really not trust me? What
kinda leader
am I if no one feels like
they can talk to me?
Damn it!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Ama.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh right! What did ya think of my
performance?
Did I seem more
trustworthy 'cause I was acting
like Fuji?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You've lost it lately. The Ama I know
wouldn't try
to be someone else.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: What!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What happened to all that passion you
show in
your races? No way you're giving
anyone advice
like this.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
At least I wouldn't think to lean on
someone
who's forgotten how to be
herself.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
That's harsh, but... you're right. I was
trying silly
tricks when I shoulda faced
my problem head-on.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks for the wake-up call. It's time
to solve
this properly!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Later, Hishi Amazon resolves her
resident's problem, and seems delighted
when more
students start coming to her
for help afterwards.
